scenarios.name: Add and remove a ribbon command in quick access

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
"Shell" is visible in the 3D Model Modify panel
"Shell" is absent from the quick-access toolbar
the user right-clicks "Shell" and selects "Add to Quick Access Toolbar"
a Shell icon appears in the quick-access toolbar
the user reopens the ribbon command context menu
"Add to Quick Access Toolbar" is unavailable
the user right-clicks the added Shell icon in the quick-access toolbar
its menu offers "Remove from Quick Access Toolbar"
the user selects "Remove from Quick Access Toolbar"
the added Shell icon disappears from the toolbar
the ribbon command context menu offers "Add to Quick Access Toolbar" again
